rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-evidence/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill, recognized by its front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions`.

Its front-matter `description` begins "Use when Habeas evidence needs creating or refreshing, or when `habeas coverage` or `habeas status` reports Habeas findings...". It then lists the situations that call for the skill: missing, stale or false evidence, uncovered `{test}` lines, FIXME judgments, and disagreeing assessments. It also covers the user who "only says 'the habeas test is failing'". These are all stated in terms of the user's task and the symptoms the user sees, which meets the MUST.

The description also says "If evidence went stale because code or requirements moved, use habeas-refactor first." The requirement allows naming another bundled skill (MAY) where an agent could confuse the two. `assets/skills/habeas-refactor` exists, so the reference is valid, and the named skill is a plausible confusion.

No obligation is unmet.
